Ruled: updateMfaPreference is channel-only, setVerifiedPhone is the sole writer, and the gate checks phoneVerifiedAt (verified) rather than mere existence. Applied at 775dc28917.

surprises.item: F-11: resendPhoneEnrolmentCode refused a cross-account caller only AFTER sendChallengeCode had charged the VICTIM's send budget. The ownership check was correct and every outcome-level invariant held; the defect was a SIDE EFFECT on the way to a correct refusal.
surprises.disposition: Found by running the wrong-session limb 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z scored E1 PARTIAL for omitting -- after I had already reported green. No source read could have found it: the check reads correctly because it IS correct. Fixed 688e37909a (check moved above the charge), hardened 14a88f66c9 (owner param REQUIRED, with a measured negative control: an omitting caller gives TS2554, rc=2), deployed and re-verified 1->0. It is the same position error I had ALREADY fixed in verifyEnrolmentChallenge in the same commit, while writing the paragraph about why position matters.

surprises.item: My own E1w test script prints a HARDCODED deployed-sha in its banner, and it was STALE at the re-run.
surprises.disposition: The banner read gmJnyiaSC while the live function was RIAv5cTF. A reader spot-checking that line would have concluded the PASS was measured on the build that still had the bug. The result stands because the old build produced sends 0->1 and this run produced 0->0 -- the flip ITSELF identifies which bytes answered, an artifact certifying its own plane. The banner should READ the sha, not carry it: measured-not-asserted, applied to the instrument rather than only to its subject.
